【原视频简介】
What happens when an abandoned DJI Phantom 3 drone is found after a serious crash?

This DJI Phantom 3 was discovered in badly damaged and neglected condition after apparently suffering a fall. The body was damaged, parts were worn, and the electronics needed a complete inspection.

Instead of throwing this old drone away, I decided to take on the challenge of restoring it.

This video follows the complete restoration process—from the initial inspection and disassembly to repairing the damaged components, rebuilding the drone, powering it up, and finally testing whether it can fly again.
